_readme: THE ART FENCE (PLUMBER 10/19/26, VAMILY row [the art fence]; rule 100(f): 'a commit by an art lane touching slices/ or engine/ is red unless the VOTE registry holds his FINAL verdict on that asset's family; the fence reads the lane from the commit's first word'; rule 101(c): 'an art lane's edit to a placeholder file is red'). Read by gates/art_fence_gate.py. The window is every commit after born_after (or, where a shallow clone does not reach it, every commit it holds dated after born_date). moodboard_landed stays null until his pictures are in the bible (rule 108 round thirteen, 10/11: 'no art reaches FINAL before his pictures are in the bible'); the coordinator sets it to {date, record}. A family enters the game only through finals: {card, globs, why}, the card his FINAL in the registry's verdicts (his words, never a lane's). answered: [{sha, why}] clears a red commit once it is reverted or the coordinator rules on it (the why names the revert's sha or the ruling's record); a history gate with no way to answer stays red forever.
